name: Releasing in a dungeon wing revives the player at the wing's start
contract: A player who releases in a dungeon with wings is revived at the start of the wing they are in, not at the dungeon's front door. On Mythic, Shadowfang Keep has two wings: Arugal's Rise starts in the courtyard (its Dungeon Finder start, lfg_dungeon_template 3321: -294.299, 2305.1) and Halls of the Damned at the entrance (-229.135, 2109.18). A Mythic player who dies in the courtyard and releases is revived on map 33 at the Arugal's Rise start, about 220 yards from the entrance.
